verified_facts.text: The private Monarch Bay Beach Club is exclusive to registered guests and members.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exclusive to registered guests and members, the private Monarch Bay Beach Club is an oceanfront sanctuary.

verified_facts.text: Monarch Bay Beach Club has an indoor-outdoor bar and offers sunset dinners on the Beach Lawn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the warm ocean breeze through our indoor-outdoor bar or the laid-back luxury of a sunset dinner on the spacious Beach Lawn.

verified_facts.text: Guests can ride a little tram down to the private Monarch Bay Beach Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: they hop an adorable little tram down to the private Monarch Bay Beach Club for drinks, dinner, and a show—the sunset

verified_facts.text: Bourbon Steak Orange County is Chef Michael Mina's take on the American steakhouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bourbon Steak Orange County is Chef Michael Mina’s nod to the American steakhouse experience.

verified_facts.text: Bourbon Steak's cocktail program pairs classic 20th-century cocktails with modern-day interpretations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the distinctions of classic 20th-century cocktails alongside modern-day interpretations.

verified_facts.text: AVEO Table + Bar has a rotating seasonal menu with ingredients predominantly grown or caught in Southern California.
verified_facts.excerpt: A rotating seasonal menu showcases local seafood, prime filets, savory sandwiches, and fresh salads, with ingredients predominantly grown or caught in Southern California.

verified_facts.text: 33 North is the resort's coastal-inspired living room with a bar, a fireplace and an outdoor terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join friends and family in our coastal-inspired “living room,” with its stylish bar, cozy fireplace, and sweeping outdoor terrace.

verified_facts.text: Sombra Cantina is a poolside cantina serving fish tacos, salads and ceviche.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our poolside cantina and kitchen is ideal for the whole family, with authentic and approachable favorites including fish tacos, salads, and ceviche.

verified_facts.text: Part + Parcel Market offers market-fresh foods, curated picnic baskets, fresh juices, smoothies and La Colombe coffee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Part + Parcel Market offers market-fresh foods, curated picnic baskets, and other culinary delights including fresh juices, smoothies, and La Colombe coffee.

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Room service is available 24 hours a day.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was built in 2001 and operated for many years as a St. Regis resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built in 2001 atop the Monarch Bay, this hotel operated for many years as a St. Regis resort.

verified_facts.text: In early 2021 the resort joined the Waldorf Astoria Collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: In early 2021, after a few years as an independent hotel, the Monarch Beach Resort joined the Waldorf Astoria Collection

verified_facts.text: The resort's golf course was designed by Robert Trent Jones, Jr.
verified_facts.excerpt: the golf course (designed by Robert Trent Jones, Jr.)

verified_facts.text: The resort sits about a half mile back from the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Waldorf Astoria Monarch Beach sits a little bit back from the beach, about a half mile

verified_facts.text: There are two pools, one dedicated to families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Down at the pools—there are two, with one dedicated just for families

verified_facts.text: The Monarch Beach Kids Club is open to children ages 5 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Monarch Beach Kids Club nearby is open for children ages 5-12

verified_facts.text: Several ground-floor rooms have patios leading out to the pool area.
verified_facts.excerpt: For families, there are several rooms on the ground floor with patios that lead out to the pool area.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have Salvatore Ferragamo toiletries, a soaking tub and dual marble vanities.
verified_facts.excerpt: complete with Salvatore Ferragamo toiletries, a soaking tub with a window out to the guest room (and shutters to close for privacy), and dual marble vanities

verified_facts.text: Bed linens are imprinted with monarch butterflies.
verified_facts.excerpt: crisp white linens imprinted with monarch butterflies, a nod to the area’s colorful inhabitants

verified_facts.text: The resort charges a daily resort fee.

verified_facts.text: Pets under 35 pounds are welcome for a non-refundable fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets under 35 pounds are welcome, but require a $200 non-refundable fee.
